levels.note: Three atomic-testable leaves. Build and verify each in isolation via its own unittest class (ClockTests, FormatterTests, ParserTests). Order among them is independent; C-001 before C-002 only because C-002's tests format a datetime the clock conceptually supplies.
Compose the three verified leaves into main(); verify end-to-end via EndToEndTests (real CLI invocations: default, --time, --utc --time, --bogus).

repair_protocol.on_component_fail: Builder reworks the single failing component within its scope (one function in isodate.py); re-run that component's unittest class; max_iterations_per_component then escalate.
repair_protocol.on_integration_fail: Drill DOWN: rank C-001/C-002/C-003 by likelihood using contract mismatch + acceptance gaps (e.g. wrong stdout format => suspect C-002 formatter; wrong exit code on bad flag => suspect C-003 parser; wrong UTC/local => suspect C-001 clock). Mark suspects failed, rebuild/upgrade, re-verify the leaf, then re-compose C-000 and re-run EndToEndTests; climb again.
